scripts.prepare-art: node scripts/prepare-oven.mjs && node scripts/prepare-portrait.mjs && node scripts/prepare-props.mjs
scripts.prepare-all: npm run prepare-art && npm run prepare-assets
scripts.build: npm run prepare-all && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.standalone: npm run prepare-all && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode standalone && node scripts/build-standalone.mjs
